entries.anchor: Item 3b — bug issues only: red-before-green evidence (REQUIRED).
entries.rationale: Item 3b offered a bare git worktree prune to reconcile a leftover temp worktree; that prune also deletes the admin dir of any other moved-but-unrepaired worktree (ai-dossier#1232). git worktree remove --force clears a leftover even when its folder is gone, so prune is never needed here.
